blocking_findings: Runtime reads contract.behavior, but the database contract returns contract.behavioral. Runtime therefore rejects every target while the database/exporter report 4004 behavioral candidates.
The parity export aliases the same database value as both contract and direct_contract, so its 5204 equalities do not test runtime interpretation and could not detect the runtime key defect.
Non-OK upload responses do not clear the client's cached terminal attempt ID, so a user retry can reuse the closed attempt.
The retry fixture merely inserts two chosen UUID rows and does not exercise the route or client retry behavior.
No concurrent terminal-review test is present.
Full-binding replay tests alter only restaurant and menu item, not every binding field.
Gold-failure tests do not assert the absence of verified_comparison_created receipts.
The every-gate matrix omits direct tests for distinctFromCustomer and lacksVerifiedCustomerSameDish.
The supplied adversarial JSON contains summary labels, not test names and captured assertions.
The selector reconciliation is empty and reports no explicit old/new population totals or delta.
The 3912-to-3881 drift file repeats a narrative timing explanation without aggregate gate-state evidence.
